tools_used: CourtListener MCP opinion search and document reader
helpful: The stage- and moment-specific prompt made the merits scoring axis and declared claims unambiguous.
The statpack exposed the exact strictly-prior merits baseline and its coverage.
The filed petition and cert response contained both sides' core statutory arguments.
gaps: The grant-moment snapshot was not frozen at the grant date.
The brief-in-opposition artifact merged a cert response with a later merits brief instead of preserving one filing per document.
notes: I excluded post-grant material to preserve the event's grant-moment information set and recorded the document/snapshot mismatch in flags.json.
